constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (periode_id) REFERENCES eo_kp_periode(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (master_rubrik_id) REFERENCES eo_kp_master_rubrik(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('menunggu'::character varying)::text, ('disetujui'::character varying)::text, ('ditolak'::character varying)::text, ('dibatalkan'::character varying)::text])))
FOREIGN KEY (fasilitas_id) REFERENCES eo_mr_fasilitas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (ruangan_id) REFERENCES eo_mr_ruangans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (((approval_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('pending'::character varying)::text, ('approved'::character varying)::text, ('rejected'::character varying)::text, ('revision'::character varying)::text])))
